senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; לבן to stamp, tread, cmp. לבד; v. Schr. KAT2, p. 121 note) brick.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:13">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 24:10">Ex. XXIV, 10</cite>, cmp. Targ. Y.

<cite ref="Exodus 24:10">ib.</cite>) <he>זה עד שלא נגאלו אבל משנגאלו היכן היתה דרכה של ל׳ להנתן וכ׳</he> this (brick of sapphire under his feet) was before they (the Israelites) were redeemed, but after their redemption the brick was placed where it belonged.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 9:6">Kel. IX, 6</cite> <he>ל׳ שבלעה וכ׳</he> a brick in which a metal ring has entirely disappeared; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:5">Tosef. Mikv. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 7:12">VII</cite>), 12 <he>טבעת שנתונה בל׳ וכ׳</he> a ring which was stuck into a brick of soft clay.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 46a:20">Ab. Zar. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>שזקף ל׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00649"><he>זָקַף</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לְבֵנִים</he>, <cite ref="L00103"><he>לְבֵי׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:23">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 48:21">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVIII</cite> <he>בין לובן הל׳</he> between the layers of bricks.
B. Bath. I, 1; a. fr.—Trnsf. l’benah, the larger portion of a line filled out with writing; [Rashi: the blank], v. אָרִיחַ.
